verdict.rationale: Riveter documents a scrape endpoint that turns a URL into 'easily parseable text', but nothing in the evidence shows an option to return semantically chunked output instead of one content blob. Parseable text is an adjacent feature, not chunking. A web-scraping and data API could plausibly offer chunked output, so the axis applies and the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can request semantically chunked output instead of one large content blob, so it feeds cleanly into a retrieval pipeline
